verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.dagster.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index of the Dagster docs, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The docs also have a dedicated AI-tools section, including the dagster-expert skill that gives coding agents context and patterns for building Dagster projects. Missing for 10: any evidence of an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown variants, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
